title: Mahesh Saptharishi, Executive Vice President and CTO, Motorola Solutions, to Participate in the Piper Sandler Growth Frontiers Conference
summary: Mahesh Saptharishi, Executive Vice President and CTO, Motorola Solutions, to Participate in the Piper Sandler Growth Frontiers Conference
body_markdown:
**CHICAGO – September 9, 2026** – Motorola Solutions (NYSE: MSI), a global leader in mission-critical safety and security solutions, today announced that Mahesh Saptharishi, Executive Vice President and CTO, will participate at the upcoming Piper Sandler Growth Frontiers Conference on Wednesday, September 16, 2026 at 09:00 a.m. CT.


A live webcast and replay of the session will be featured on Motorola Solutions’ Investor Relations website at[www.motorolasolutions.com/investor](http://www.motorolasolutions.com/investors) .


**About Motorola Solutions | Solving for safer** Safety and security are at the heart of everything we do at Motorola Solutions. We build and connect technologies to help protect people, property and places. Our solutions foster the collaboration that’s critical for safer communities, safer schools, safer hospitals, safer businesses, and ultimately, safer nations. Learn more about our commitment to innovating for a safer future for us all at[www.motorolasolutions.com](http://www.motorolasolutions.com/) .
